sequence_basis: Monotone voltage ramp; recorded WAVs and experiment notes anchor 1.0 through 2.0 V; low-voltage ramp is checked against logger plateaus
selection: Longest continuous interval covered by jointly stable time windows within each applied-voltage stage
resistance_note: Use the current notebook value; software configuration is not a metrological confirmation
recording_alignment: Voltage-stage representative label; recording/logger clock synchronization is not assumed
